# QuizBall

> QuizBall is an independent 1v1 multiplayer football trivia game. Correct answers influence possession, attacking momentum and goals in football-style matches.

Official website: https://quizball.io/

## Authoritative pages

- About QuizBall: https://quizball.io/en/about
- Verified product facts and brand resources: https://quizball.io/en/press
- Editorial methodology: https://quizball.io/en/editorial-methodology
- Football Knowledge Index 2026: https://quizball.io/en/football-knowledge-index
- Aggregate report data: https://quizball.io/data/quizball-football-knowledge-index-2026.csv
- Free football quizzes: https://quizball.io/en/football-quiz
- Spanish football quizzes: https://quizball.io/es/quiz-de-futbol
- Spanish product facts: https://quizball.io/es/press

## Product facts

- QuizBall combines football trivia with live 1v1 match mechanics.
- Ranked play, friendly matches, Auction, Football Grid and Tic-Tac-Toe are distinct game modes.
- Public search quizzes and the ranked-match question pool have separate publication controls.
- Public football quiz content is available in English and Spanish; the product interface also supports Georgian.
- QuizBall documents how questions are researched, reviewed, updated and corrected.

## Editorial note

QuizBall is not affiliated with, endorsed by or sponsored by any club, league, federation or competition organizer. Club, competition and player names are used for editorial identification.

For corrections or verification requests: support@quizball.io
